evidence_tree.method: git archive --format=tar HEAD data docs/math-foundations.md | tar -x -C <scratch>

sources.quote: Dealing {{as|physical damage}} to an enemy champion applies a stack of ''Carve'' for 6 seconds, stacking up to 5 times. Each stack inflicts {{as|6% armor reduction}}, up to {{as|30%|armor}} at 5 stacks.
sources.reading: Carve is a debuff on the ENEMY: it reduces the target's armor. Armor is a property of the target, so once applied it lowers mitigation for every source of physical damage hitting that target, not just the Cleaver holder.

sources.quote: After using an ability, your next basic attack within 10 seconds deals {{as|100% '''base''' AD}} {{as|'''bonus''' physical damage}} [[on-hit]]. If the target is a champion, inflict them with ''Expose Weakness'' for 4 seconds, causing them to take {{rd|8%|5%}} increased damage from all sources ({{fd|1.5}} second cooldown, starts after using the empowered attack).
sources.reading: Expose Weakness is a debuff on the TARGET and the wiki says explicitly 'increased damage from all sources' - i.e. it amplifies damage dealt by every roster member, not only the Bloodsong holder.

sources.where: data/items.json, {{rd|melee|ranged}} template convention, corroborated across 62 usages
sources.quote: Tiamat / Ravenous Hydra: {{rd|40% AD|20% AD}} ; Titanic Hydra: {{rd|4%|2%}} ; Hullbreaker: {{rd|120%|{{ap|120*0.7}}...}} ; Blade of the Ruined King: {{rd|9%|6%}}
sources.reading: First argument is the melee value, second the ranged value. Bloodsong therefore reads 8% (melee) / 5% (ranged) Expose Weakness amplification.
Post-mitigation damage = raw * 100/(100 + effective_armor); the R consumed is the TARGET's current armor, i.e. after any armor reduction debuff.

sources.quote: The game applies, in order: flat reduction -> percentage reduction -> percentage penetration -> flat penetration ... R_final = max(0, (R - r_flat)*(1 - r_pct/100)*(1 - p) - f)
sources.reading: Carve's 30% is a percentage REDUCTION applied to the target's armor before any penetration; it is a property of the target's resistance state, shared by all attackers.

sources.quote: 3071: atom 'damage.resistance-mitigation' behavior 'Carve' ; 3877: passive 'Spellblade' atoms under behavior 'Spellblade'
sources.reading: Structured corroboration that Carve acts through the resistance-mitigation path (target-side) rather than as an attacker-local stat.

sources.quote: grant you 8% increased damage against champions until 5 seconds after exiting combat with them
sources.reading: Checked as a possible confounder for a shared amplifier; PtA's amp is explicitly attacker-local ('grant YOU'), so it cannot supply the shared multiplier observed here. No other rune in the cache carries a shared damage amplifier.

independent_computation.factorization: 7/6 = (10/9) * 1.05, i.e. a mitigation-ratio factor of 10/9 from an armor reduction plus a 1.05 damage amplifier.

identified_factors.amplifier: 1.05 = Bloodsong 'Expose Weakness', ranged branch of {{rd|8%|5%}} (S2, S3). Applies to all sources, hence to this roster member's event.
identified_factors.armor_reduction: 10/9 = (100 + 50) / (100 + 35): the target's armor 50 reduced 30% by 5 stacks of Black Cleaver 'Carve' (S1) -> 35, mitigated per m(R) = 100/(100+R) (S4).

forward_derivation: Back out the pre-mitigation damage implied by the OLD value under un-shredded armor A = 50: raw = 138.6 * (100 + 50)/100 = 138.6 * 1.5 = 207.9.

Apply Carve at cap (5 stacks x 6% = 30%, S1) to the TARGET's armor: A_eff = 50 * (1 - 0.30) = 35. (Percentage reduction, applied before any penetration per S5; no penetration is required for the fit - see consistency_check.)
Apply Expose Weakness, 5% increased damage from all sources (S2, S3): 154.0 * 1.05 = 161.70.
Result: 161.7 - matches the NEW value exactly to the golden's 0.1 precision.

consistency_check.roundness: The reconstruction lands on exactly round intermediates (raw 207.9, target armor 50, post-shred armor 35, post-mitigation 154.0), which is what a correct model of this scenario should produce.
consistency_check.penetration_invariance: Solving generally, the 10/9 factor requires E_new = (9*E_old - 100)/10. With E_old = 50 this gives E_new = 35, i.e. exactly 0.30 * A * (1 - p) = 15 with flat pen f = 0. Any penetration profile satisfying A*(1-p) = 50 reproduces the same result, so the conclusion does not depend on assuming zero penetration - only on Carve being at its 30% cap.
consistency_check.alternative_decomposition: A second self-consistent fit exists (target armor 125, Carve at 3 stacks = 18% -> 102.5 armor, same 1.05 amp): 311.85 * 100/202.5 * 1.05 = 161.7. It yields the identical answer, so the verdict is robust to which of the two the scenario actually configures. Both require the 5% Expose Weakness amp and a shared Carve shred.
rejected_alternatives: Carve alone with no amp: requires target armor 90.91 (30% shred) or 147.06 (24% shred) - not round, and leaves the wiki's explicit 'increased damage from all sources' unmodelled.
Melee branch (8%) of Expose Weakness with a Carve shred: needs target armor 32.91 (30% shred) or 44.83 (24% shred) - non-round, so the event-61 attacker is the ranged branch.
Additive stacking of two 8% amps (1.16) gives 160.8, not 161.7; a bare 8%x8% multiplicative double-count (1.1664) gives 161.66 but has no source - no second Expose Weakness exists (unique passive).

Negative-armor path m(R) = 2 - 100/(100-R) (math-foundations 2.1) would give 7/6 at R = -20 armor, but nothing in the cache drives this target's armor negative: Carve is a PERCENTAGE reduction and the wiki rule quoted in math-foundations 2.3 states percentage armor reduction cannot reduce armor below 0. Rejected.

independent_computation.why_old_is_wrong: 138.6 is exactly raw * 100/(100 + A) with the target's UNSHREDDED armor and no Expose Weakness amplifier - i.e. this roster member's damage event saw neither of the two debuffs its allies had placed on the target. Both cached sources are unambiguous that these are target-side debuffs: Carve reduces the enemy champion's armor (S1, S5, S6), and Expose Weakness causes the target 'to take ... increased damage from all sources' (S2). A coupled-roster event that ignores them under-reports damage.

residual_assumptions: The scenario's own configuration file was NOT read (it lives outside data/ and docs/math-foundations.md), so target armor, penetration and the attacker's melee/ranged status were reconstructed from the two golden values plus the cached wiki text rather than observed directly.

The reconstruction assumes the event-61 attacker is ranged (5% Expose Weakness). If that attacker were melee, the correct value would be 166.3 and both values would be wrong; the melee reading is rejected here because it forces a non-round target armor (32.9 / 44.8) while the ranged reading lands on exact round intermediates.
